title: Homologous Series
notes:
Homologous Series

Series of compounds with the same functional group where consecutive members differ by a −CH₂− unit (14 amu molecular weight difference).
• Alkanes: CH₄, C₂H₆, C₃H₈, C₄H₁₀
• Alcohols: CH₃OH, C₂H₅OH, C₃H₇OH, C₄H₉OH
summary: Incremental structural progression in homologous series.
